pages.text: The $(l)Shuriken$() is the go-to early weapon. See Tinkers' Builds for full builds.

$(l)Target build:$() Dragon Bone (put it first so repairs are easy until it's unbreakable), Enderium, Fluxed Electrum, and Terrasteel or Red Matter, with $(l)Nickel embossment$(), which makes every hit a crit.

$(li)Make it $(l)unbreakable$() (5 Reinforced modifiers, applied one at a time), level it up, then add as much Nether Quartz as you can.$(li)Each throw costs durability. Throws that miss can be picked back up.$(li)$(l)Don't$() add paper or Magical Wood just for modifier slots.

Tool XP comes quickly, and Magical Wood's $(o)Magically Brittle$() trait can break even an unbreakable tool.$(li)Easier materials: Fluxed Electrum = silver + gold + redstone. Enderium needs platinum (from nickel/iridium byproducts).
Terrasteel is possible in Chapter 1 with a dozen Endoflames and half a mana pool.

$(li)Shurikens shred Ice & Fire dragons but are weak against the Ender Dragon.$(li)Katanas also work well. Tinkers' armor is mediocre.$(li)Found a dragon skeleton? Keep right-clicking it for $(l)dragon bones$(), which make strong budget weapons.
